goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
cues: Bell at your chest, elbows down.
Sit between your heels, chest tall.
Knees track over your middle toes.
goblet-squat.x: Heels lifting? Widen your stance slightly.
goblet-squat.setup: Bell held by the horns · feet just wider than hips

pullup-negative.name: Pull-up negative
cues: Step up so your chin starts over the bar.
Brace, then lower as slowly as you can.
Step back up for each rep.
pullup-negative.setup: Box or bench under the bar · overhand, hands just outside shoulders

video.q: pull up negatives form E3 Rehab

backup.src: Master the Negative Pull-Up in 30 Seconds

db-bench.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched.
Lower to chest level, elbows about 45°.
Press up and slightly in.
db-bench.setup: Blackwing flat · bells on knees, kick back to start

video.q: dumbbell bench press technique Jeff Nippard

backup.src: How to Do the Flat Dumbbell Bench Press

db-rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips back.
Bells slide down the front of your legs.
Stop at the hamstring stretch, stand tall.
db-rdl.setup: Feet hip-width · bells in front of thighs, overhand grip

video.q: dumbbell romanian deadlift form Jeff Nippard

kb-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Bell a foot in front; hinge and grab it.
Hike it back high between your thighs.
Snap hips forward, bell floats to chest height.
Arms are ropes; the hips do the work.
kb-swing.x: Lifting with your arms? Hinge more.

backup.src: How To Do a Proper Kettlebell Swing

kb-deadlift.name: Kettlebell deadlift
cues: Bell between your mid-feet.
Hips back, flat back, grip hard.
Push the floor away, stand tall.
kb-deadlift.x: Squatting it up? Hips back more.
kb-deadlift.setup: Feet hip-width, bell under your laces

backup.src: How To Do A Kettlebell Deadlift

db-row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Knee and hand on the bench, back flat.
Pull your elbow toward your hip.
Pause one second at the top.
db-row.setup: Blackwing flat · same-side knee and hand on the pad

video.q: one arm dumbbell row form E3 Rehab

backup.src: How to Do a Single Arm Dumbbell Row

incline-db-press.name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Bench about 30° (2nd or 3rd notch).
Lower to upper chest, elbows under wrists.
Press up; don't clank the bells.
incline-db-press.setup: Blackwing at about 30° · bells on knees to start

video.q: incline dumbbell press form Jeff Nippard

split-squat.name: Split squat
cues: Long stance; hold the bench for balance.
Drop the back knee straight down.
Front heel stays down; drive through it.
split-squat.x: Back toe sore? Swap to a goblet squat.
split-squat.setup: Hold the bench for balance at first

farmer-carry.name: Farmer carry
cues: Pick up like a deadlift, flat back.
Tall posture, shoulders down and back.
Short, steady steps; breathe.
farmer-carry.setup: Clear a straight path, shoes on

video.q: farmers carry how to Squat University
